descriptionByLocale.en:
ICT Security Engineer Content Delivery and Edge Services - Swatch Group ICT Security Engineer Content Delivery and Edge Services Introduction de la société We don't exclusively manufacture legendary watches; we keep in time with technology! The Swatch Group Services' IT division plays a key role in the digital transformation of a global leader in watchmaking. At the heart of innovation, you will help design high-performing technological solutions serving iconic brands. For our growing team into the Systems & Infrastructure team, we are looking for a motivated: ICT Security Engineer (Content Delivery & Edge Services) Description du poste You will design, implement, and maintain Akamai security and performance solutions to ensure the optimal security and availability of Swatch Group’s digital platforms. You will collaborate with internal teams and external providers to integrate CDN services into our infrastructure, automate workflows, and enhance global content distribution for Swatch Group brands. In this role, you will be responsible to: Design, deploy, and optimize Akamai CDN solutions (Ion, Image Manager, Kona Site Defender, EdgeWorkers) for high availability and low latency; Implement edge caching strategies, traffic offload, and acceleration techniques to improve web performance; Implement and maintain security and bot management rules; Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for CDN configuration and automation; Collaborate with application teams to ensure seamless integration of CDN services with enterprise platforms; Manage infrastructure as code (IaC) for CDN and cloud environments using tools like Terraform or Ansible; Monitor and analyze CDN performance metrics, availability, and security posture using Akamai Control Center and analytics tools; Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to CDN security; Ensure compliance with security best practices for CDN and edge deployments Profil Bachelor degree or equivalent in Computer Science; Certifications such as GIAC GWAS, Azure Security Engineer, Palo Alto PCNSE and Akamai Certified Professional are a plus; Good knowledge of enterprise security technologies: firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet), VPN, endpoint protection, WAF; Good knowledge of web application security and CDN integration across digital platforms; Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, CircleCI); Proficiency in IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting languages (Python, Bash); Knowledge of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP); Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic stack); 
• Compétences requises Professional experience of minimum 5 years in an equivalent role Effective communication across technical and non-technical teams; Team-oriented with a collaborative mindset; Detail-oriented and precise in execution; Service-oriented with a strong customer focus. Langues Fluent in English French, and German are a plus Any other languages are welcome Personne de contact Aliénor Dro Lieu de travail Longue-Rue / Länggasse 85 2504 Biel/Bienne (Bern) Suisse Adresse de l'entreprise The Swatch Group Services SA Chemin du Long-Champ 119 CH-2504 Bienne Postuler pour ce poste Partagez cette annonce
